reviewed_by: Codex focused review for follow-up queue disclosure
reason: The queue panel now lets operators collapse a needs-attention follow-up and reopen it while retaining the status summary. Five collected component cases cover default disclosure, attention, transition, reconciliation, and edit interaction. Eight collected browser cases cover the queue journey at desktop 1440/1024 and emulated Chromium/WebKit phone widths of 320/390/430. Four collected real-Core cases cover durable review state, reload, and production LAN controls at desktop and emulated 390 px phones.
exclusions: No backend or native code changed, so Python and native tests are excluded. Unrelated UI and browser suites and full suites are excluded. Physical-device testing is unavailable locally and is not claimed.
